programs.title: The Life and Art of Han Meilin Ep.3
programs.desc: This documentary explores the breadth and depth of artist Han Meilin's work. Witness a vision for the new era of Chinese aesthetics, from the Chinese spirit embedded in his sculptures to the fusion of tradition and modernity.
